rag.text:
Test: TC-5957 — New Homepage - Quick links
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/New Homepage

Steps:
1. Navigate to New Homepage
   Expected: New Homepage screen is visible. There are seven tiles in quick links section:

* Overview
* Gantt
* OKR
* Startegic Areas
* Priorities
* Financials
* +
2. Click nameTile.

Find boxName in the Navigator.

Click buttonName of boxName.
   Data: nameTile: Overview

boxName: TC-5957

buttonName: Overview
   Expected: Overview module of TC-5957 box is visible.
3. Click BigPicture logo from left upper corner.

Click nameTile.

Find boxName in the Navigator.

Click buttonName of boxName.
   Data: nameTile: Gantt

boxName: TC-5957

buttonName: Gantt
   Expected: Gantt module of TC-5957 box is visible.
4. Click BigPicture logo from left upper corner.

Click nameTile.

Find boxName in the Navigator.

Click buttonName of boxName.
   Data: nameTile: OKR

boxName: TC-5957

buttonName: OKR
   Expected: OKR module of TC-5957 box is visible.
5. Click BigPicture logo from left upper corner.

Click nameTile.
   Data: nameTile: Strategic Areas
   Expected: Strategic areas module is visible.
6. Click BigPicture logo from left upper corner.

Click nameTile.

Select moduleName.

Click ‘Pin to navigation’ button.
   Data: nameTile: +

moduleName: Teams
   Expected: Teams tile is appeared in Quick links section.
7. Click nameTile.

Find boxName in the Navigator.

Click buttonName of boxName.
   Data: nameTile: Teams

boxName: TC-5957

buttonName: Gantt
   Expected: Gantt module of TC-5957 box is visible.
8. Click BigPicture logo from left upper corner.

Hover over tileName and click 'x' icon.
   Data: tileName: Teams
   Expected: Teams tile is removed from Quick links.
9. Drag and drop tileName one spot on the left.
   Data: tileName: OKR
   Expected: OKR tile is between Overview tile and Gantt tile.
